description: Migrates .NET Framework WCF services to CoreWCF on modern .NET, including service hosts, contracts, clients, configuration, dependencies, tests, and deployment. Combines a .NET engine assessment with AI WCF analysis and a dependency-ordered plan. Use when asked to "upgrade WCF", "migrate to CoreWCF", or a WCF package, assembly, binding, endpoint, ServiceHost, System.ServiceModel, or .svc upgrade that requires server migration rather than a version bump. Does not migrate client-only System.ServiceModel package updates or already-migrated CoreWCF version bumps.
